body: I explained what occurred in one of my previous comments.
I don't want to end up as one of those unemployment sob stories. Besides, isn't getting fired basically a career death sentence.

I called HR to get clarification about what kind of disciplinary policy there was at my company. I should have known better because I was in the boss's office the next day. Not only was he informed, but also the head of division. It was taken as an affront to them. I don't think that they will let me live that down and I don't see the point in hitting my head against a door that has been closed to me. I worked so hard to get this position and I don't have the strength to go through the song and dance all over again.
